title: Jesus Plays Cricket, Modi's PR Stunt, Delhi Smog & The Hijab
description:
Welcome to WTF News – the only show that filters faith, superstition, and political spin through one thing the gods forgot to invent: common sense.

In this episode, we look at how religion once again gatecrashed logic across India. From Jemimah Rodrigues thanking Jesus for a cricket win (and the Internet losing it), to Delhi’s fake clean Yamuna for Chhath Puja, smog sensors being hosed to fake better AQI, and Kerala’s never-ending hijab controversy – this week, belief truly beat science on the scoreboard.

Watch how blind faith keeps hijacking headlines — whether it’s politicians bathing in filtered holy water or schools debating scarves instead of science. Because in India, logic may take a backseat, but satire never does.

If you’ve searched for religion in Indian news, Jemimah Rodrigues Jesus controversy, fake Yamuna ghat, Delhi AQI scam, or Kerala hijab row, this video gives you the rational perspective. Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share to keep reason alive.

⏱️ CHAPTERS

00:00 – Intro: WTF News Returns with More Divine Madness
01:30 – Jesus Takes the Bat: Jemimah’s Faith & Fury
02:00 – Holy Water for VIPs: The Fake Yamuna Ghat
03:50 – Delhi’s Magic Air: When Pollution Meets Photoshop
05:20 – Kerala’s Hijab Row: Uniformity vs. Faith
07:20 – Faith vs Logic: The Weekly Roundup
08:45 – Outro: Stay Questioning, Stay Curious
